//: Secrets are deliberately empty here and are never committed with a value. In Production they come from the flat machine environment variables named below, which outrank this file; in Development, from dotnet user-secrets. See docs/windows-service.md.

Ingestion.//: Folder the Worker watches for notices. Not a secret, so it may be set here; Ingestion__WatchedFolder overrides it. Created on startup if missing, and the service refuses to start if it cannot read and write there.
Ingestion.//ArchiveFolder: Where processed/ and failed/ live. Blank means under the watched folder, which is the usual arrangement.
Ingestion.//MaxReadAttempts: Consecutive read failures before a file is moved to failed/. Applies to unreadable files only; a file that read fine but could not be recorded stays for ever, because the watched folder is the queue while the database is down.

Extraction.//: Provider choice is a configuration value, not a code path - see ADR 0001. A provider with no ApiKey or no ModelId is not registered at all.

Claude.//ModelId: Pinned, never a floating alias: two rows with the same name and different behaviour would make the accuracy report meaningless. #68 carries the model table; claude-sonnet-4-6 is the extraction model.
Claude.//SendsPdfNatively: The reason ADR 0001 chose Claude. The PDF goes as a document, so a rate table keeps which tranche owns which rate.

OpenAi.//: OPEN_API_KEY. The second first-class provider: #9 exists so the accuracy report has something to compare against. gpt-5-mini per #68.

Groq.//: GROQ_API_KEY. Optional, and the system runs without it. Fallback and experimentation - cheap and fast rather than most accurate. openai/gpt-oss-120b per #68.
Groq.//BaseUrl: Groq speaks the OpenAI API, so it is that client pointed here rather than a package of its own. Empty falls back to this same address.
Groq.//SendsPdfNatively: False, and this is the setting that matters most here. Groq's hosted models do not take documents, so the notice is flattened to text first - which loses the row and column association in a rate table. An accuracy report comparing this against Claude without knowing that would blame the model for a preprocessing loss.

Graph.//: Application credential and mailbox for shared-mailbox ingestion. Secrets are never committed with a value; all four arrive as machine environment variables.
Graph.//Mailbox: GRAPH_USER — the shared mailbox agent banks send to. An address, not a secret, but required: ingestion has nowhere to look without it.
Graph.//ProcessedFolder: Mail folder ingested messages are moved into. Created on first use. Moved, never deleted: the message is the original evidence.
Graph.//MessagesPerPoll: Messages fetched per poll. Unread is the queue, so anything that does not fit is picked up next time.
